solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Heavy metal scene rearranged into amazing divine proportion

parts.note: gold is a dense, heavy metallic element

indicators.note: the letters of the word scene are put into a new order
used in its old sense of bewildering or confusing, so the letters of into are jumbled

explanation.surface: A heavy-metal music scene is somehow reworked into an astonishing piece of sacred geometry.
explanation.walkthrough: Two separate anagrams: 'rearranged' works on SCENE to give ENSEC, and 'amazing' works on INTO to give TION. Heavy metal looks like a music genre but is just a metal that is heavy.
explanation.definitionFit: The ratio of roughly 1.618, prized in art and architecture, is also called the divine proportion in Chambers.

clue.text: Encourage WAGs to go out to get cheap, shoddy jewellery

parts.note: gee, as in gee up, means to urge on

indicators.note: the letters of WAGs leave their order and are rearranged, as if going out on the town

explanation.surface: Footballers' wives and girlfriends are egged on to a night out, wearing cheap bling.
explanation.walkthrough: WAGs are the wives and girlfriends of famous British footballers. 'go out' turns WAGS into GAWS.
explanation.definitionFit: Gewgaws (also spelt geegaws) are showy trinkets of little worth, so tawdry baubles of trashy jewellery.

clue.text: During Winter Olympic event, Norway go on the attack

indicators.note: the letter for Norway sits within the sled event, as something happens during an event

parts.note: the luge is a sliding sport at the Winter Olympics
N is the international vehicle registration letter for Norway

explanation.surface: A Norwegian competitor makes an aggressive move in the middle of a Winter Olympic race.
explanation.definitionFit: To thrust forward suddenly, as a fencer does, is to make an attacking movement.

clue.text: Keep up with Italian leader over Poles prevarications

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word is read from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: to keep something is to save it

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: O is the cricket scoring abbreviation for an over
N and S stand for the north and south poles

explanation.surface: An instruction to keep pace with the head of Italy, regarding the poles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses SAVE to EVAS, since the word is read upwards in a down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Prevarications are dodges and equivocations, ways of avoiding the truth or a direct reply.

clue.text: Amaze priest on TV having prevented further growth

parts.note: to stun someone is to amaze them
Father Ted is the title priest of a TV sitcom set on an Irish island

explanation.surface: A television priest astonishes viewers after somehow stopping something from growing.
explanation.walkthrough: Father Ted was a popular 1990s Channel 4 comedy about a hapless Irish priest.
explanation.definitionFit: A plant that has been stunted has had its development checked, so its growth has been halted.

clue.text: Who will help golfer design technique to finish?

parts.note: CAD is computer-aided design
to die is to come to an end

explanation.surface: A question about who might assist a golfer with course design or with polishing their technique.
explanation.definitionFit: On the course the bag-carrier assists the player, advising on clubs and lines.

clue.text: Get drunk on Ribena mixed into vermouth and then take ecstasy

indicators.note: the mixed drink letters are placed within the vermouth, as something poured into a glass

parts.note: IT is Italian vermouth, as in gin and it

indicators.note: the letters of Ribena are stirred up into a new order

parts.note: E is the common abbreviation for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A mad cocktail recipe: Ribena in vermouth followed by a pill, guaranteed to get you drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: Ribena is a British blackcurrant cordial. 'mixed' gives NEBRIA, which goes into IT, the old name for Italian vermouth.
explanation.definitionFit: To get someone drunk is to intoxicate them, the transitive verb sense of the word.

clue.text: Contents of Nature magazine redacted by MI6 in retribution

indicators.note: the contents of each word are blacked out, as in a censored document, leaving only the first and last letters

parts.note: MI6 is also known as SIS, the Secret Intelligence Service

explanation.surface: British intelligence censors the contents of a scientific journal as an act of revenge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contents of ... redacted' means the insides of Nature and magazine are blacked out, leaving NE and ME.
explanation.definitionFit: Nemesis was the Greek goddess of vengeance, and her name now means just punishment or downfall.

clue.text: 14 get back home before a medical problem

parts.note: the answer to 14 down

indicators.note: the word for being at home is turned round, reading backwards

parts.note: to be in is to be at home

explanation.surface: Clue 14 had better hurry home ahead of a health scare.
explanation.definitionFit: A rupture in which an organ pushes through the wall of its cavity is a common medical complaint.

clue.text: Provençal 1D papers reaching difficult conclusion not thought of before

parts.note: un is French for one, as in Provence, and the D is kept as it is
a ream is a quantity of paper, 500 sheets

indicators.note: the conclusion of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: Someone's ID documents from Provence are reaching an unexpectedly awkward end.
explanation.walkthrough: Read '1D' as ID papers in the surface, but cryptically it is the figure 1, turned into French, plus the letter D.
explanation.definitionFit: Something never dreamed of has not even been imagined, so it was beyond anyone's thought.

clue.text: As head of European government ultimately, Angela Merkel is upsetting Paris

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of each of the two names

parts.note: to be, as in it is, means it exists

indicators.note: upsetting the word Paris knocks its letters into a new order

explanation.surface: The German chancellor is annoying the French while one leader steers European policy.
explanation.walkthrough: This is the Greek prime minister elected in early 2015, whose anti-austerity stance troubled Berlin and Paris. 'upsetting' rearranges PARIS to IPRAS.
explanation.definitionFit: He led the Syriza party and became prime minister of Greece, a European state, in 2015.

clue.text: Asleep and off for a walk by the sea

indicators.note: off in the sense of gone bad or wrong, so the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: Someone dozing then heading off for a seaside stroll.
explanation.definitionFit: A promenade along a seafront is a level paved path for strolling.

clue.text: Measure the centre of stellar arrangement

indicators.note: the middle three letters are taken from the word stellar

explanation.surface: Gauging the very middle of some starry arrangement.
explanation.walkthrough: The three central letters of STELLAR give the answer. The setter admitted 'arrangement' was a slip: it was meant to be 'heavenly arrangement', a constellation, so here it is only padding.
explanation.definitionFit: An old English unit of length for cloth, about 45 inches, so a unit of measurement.

clue.text: Cleaner description of British subject follows statute being shortened

indicators.note: the description comes after the shortened law in the answer
the word for a statute loses its last letter

parts.note: a statute is a law
a subject of the monarch is under ER, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: A cleaner who describes Britons as subjects, following a curtailed act of Parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen; a subject lives under her. 'being shortened' drops the W from LAW.
explanation.definitionFit: One who washes clothes or linen is a cleaner by trade.

clue.text: River flowing through potatoes makes wetland

indicators.note: the river's letter runs through the middle of the potatoes, like water through a field

parts.note: mash is mashed potato
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A river flooding a potato field leaves boggy ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Low land that is waterlogged, such as a fen or bog, is a kind of wetland.

clue.text: Female ambassador starting to run

parts.note: HE, His or ... Excellency, is an ambassador's title

indicators.note: the first letter of the following word is taken

explanation.surface: A woman diplomat is about to stand for office.
explanation.definitionFit: The feminine pronoun refers to a woman, so it stands for a female person.

clue.text: Begin to invade insect enclosure raised on high

indicators.note: in a down entry the enclosure is lifted to sit above the insect

parts.note: enc is the abbreviation for enclosed or enclosure in a letter
a roach is a cockroach

explanation.surface: An invasion begins when a bug's pen is hoisted up high.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised on high' works only because this is a down answer: the enclosure sits physically above the insect in the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: To intrude gradually upon someone's territory or rights is to start invading it.

clue.text: Eagerly consume back of chrysalis

indicators.note: the adjective is read back to front

parts.note: pupal means relating to a pupa, or chrysalis

explanation.surface: Something greedily devours the rear end of a cocoon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' looks like the rear of the chrysalis but reverses PUPAL.
explanation.definitionFit: To lap something up is to accept or swallow it enthusiastically, like a cat at milk.

clue.text: Loads weapon and puts petrol in the tank when leaving Europe

parts.note: an arm is a weapon, as in firearm

indicators.note: the letter for Europe departs from the word for refuelling

parts.note: to fuel a car is to fill it with petrol

explanation.surface: Someone loads a gun and fills up the car before driving off from the Continent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when leaving' removes E from FUELS to leave FULS.
explanation.definitionFit: Quantities that can be carried in the arms are loads, so bundles.

clue.text: Nothing in 2 except a place to drink

indicators.note: the zero goes inside the answer to clue 2

parts.note: the answer to 2 down
O is zero, nothing
bar means except, as in all bar one

explanation.surface: Nothing in clue 2 except a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: The comfortable room of a British pub, once dearer than the public bar, is somewhere to have a drink.

clue.text: Roy sets out to get shellfish

indicators.note: out in the sense of wrong or disordered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man called Roy heads out to find seafood.
explanation.definitionFit: Bivalve molluscs eaten raw or used for pearls are a common type of shellfish.

clue.text: Chairman fails to finish translating tribal language

indicators.note: translating changes the form of the letters, rearranging them
the final letter of the word is dropped

explanation.surface: A chairman cannot complete his translation of a tribal tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fails to finish' drops the N from CHAIRMAN, and 'translating' rearranges CHAIRMA.
explanation.definitionFit: The Semitic tongue of the Amhara people is the official language of Ethiopia.

clue.text: Design event disheartened member of star's entourage

parts.note: a design is a plan

indicators.note: the word loses its heart, the middle letters, leaving only the ends

explanation.surface: A star's hanger-on is dispirited after an event they planned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disheartened' leaves ET from EVENT. The star is literal: a sun with orbiting bodies.
explanation.definitionFit: A world orbiting a sun is part of that star's retinue, a playful image of a celebrity's followers.

clue.text: Town centres beginning to be a bit violent

parts.note: centres are middles

indicators.note: the first letter of the following word is taken

parts.note: rough means somewhat violent

explanation.surface: Town centres are starting to get a little rough.
explanation.walkthrough: MIDDLESBROUGH is a large industrial town in north-east England.
explanation.definitionFit: A large industrial place on the River Tees in north-east England, famous for steel.

clue.text: Escort female into old city

indicators.note: the female goes inside the city's name

parts.note: Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia
she is a female pronoun

explanation.surface: Show a woman into an ancient city.
explanation.definitionFit: One who shows people to their seats or leads them in is an escort; as a verb, to guide.

clue.text: Can go further than nationalist to block atrocity

indicators.note: the letter goes into the word, blocking it in the middle

parts.note: an outrage is an atrocity

explanation.surface: A nationalist steps in to prevent an atrocity, and goes further still.
explanation.definitionFit: A gun or missile that has a longer reach than another exceeds it in distance.

clue.text: Stick poster in the place I'm indicating

parts.note: an ad is an advertisement, such as a poster
here is the spot where the speaker points

explanation.surface: Someone asks for a poster to be put up just where they point.
explanation.definitionFit: To cling or cleave to something is to stick to it.

clue.text: Very high-level ciphers broken by special tax officer capturing turncoat

indicators.note: the tax officer holds the traitor inside

parts.note: TO is a tax officer, as in inspector of taxes
a rat is a deserter or traitor

indicators.note: the code is broken, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Secret codes are cracked by a special taxman who catches a traitor.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally of the upper atmosphere, and figuratively extremely high, as in sky-high prices or levels.
